title: 4xGB300 cross-framework (latest-vs-latest)
description: Cross-framework round on two 4xGB300 pods (aarch64 Grace): 17 cases, SGLang-Diffusion against vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TRT-LLM VisualGen, ComfyUI and FastVideo. Qwen-Image-2512 retired for Qwen-Image-2.1 (1-GPU, 2-GPU, edit); MiniMax-H3 adds 4-GPU and FastH3-8-Step-V2 cases. Every published sglang cell runs main 6576e50cd5 (2026-10-11), which by then held every fix this round found; the pinned-main and fix-tree cells it replaces stay in raw/.

hardware.machine: rx devbox mm-vmm-lifecycle-1010, 2 pods (rank 0: image cases, rank 1: video cases)
hardware.topology: two Grace sockets per pod: GPU0/1 on NUMA node 0, GPU2/3 on node 1

harness_commits.c467130c4: gb300img1010 Cosmos3 cells after 11:00 UTC and gb300img1010b (Cosmos3 T2V explicit speed mode)
harness_commits.45e55dd14: fix passes gb300img1010fix / vfix, gb300vid1010fix / sfix

benchmark_repo.harness_note: Between b32615f and 45e55dd only 4cac45e changes what a competitor cell measures: before it the harness did not recognise vLLM-Omni --usp/--ring, so the Qwen-Image-2.1 2-GPU vLLM-Omni cell also got TP2 and ran on all four cards. That cell is replaced by gb300img1010vfix.
benchmark_repo.sglang_tree: DBF_SGLANG_PYTHONPATH=/scratch/gb300/sgl-main1011/python (main 6576e50cd5) for every published sglang cell; /scratch/gb300/sgl-rerun (3831e7e09 + fixes) for the superseded fix passes

frameworks.sglang: main 6576e50cd5e5817b10e12245104603eb1b0d8a4f (2026-10-11) for every published cell. Superseded: main 3831e7e09 (first pass) and 3831e7e09 + sgl-project/sglang#43565 #43568 #43577 #43575 #43576 #43584 #43586 (fix passes, rank0 cf05d511 / rank1 284d91e7), all in raw/
frameworks.lightx2v: main b6d38283cb8176303f9155e639bcd496553d3402 (0.5.0), torch 2.11.0, flash-attn 2.8.3 (FA3 skipped on aarch64)

merge.rule: build_report_artifacts: a later input replaces an earlier one per (case_id, framework)

replaced.sglang (every case): gb300img1011main / gb300vid1011main (main 6576e50cd5, 2026-10-11) replace every earlier sglang cell. The first pass ran main 3831e7e09 and lost cells to placement and compile-path bugs: unbound diffusion workers drifted to the other Grace socket (sglang#43565), and compile graph-broke or crashed. The *fix / *sfix / *f3fix passes measured 3831e7e09 plus the then-open fixes. Once all of them had merged, the column was re-run on main.
replaced.qwen_image_21_t2i_1024_2gpu (vllm-omni): gb300img1010vfix replaces a main-pass cell that ran on four GPUs (TP2 on top of --usp, before harness 4cac45e): 3.496 s there, 3.081 s on its two GPUs.
replaced.minimax_h3_fasth3_v2_t2va_5s (every fram: gb300vid1010fix replaces the main pass, where sglang rejected the request with 400 and vLLM-Omni returned 500. vLLM-Omni and FastVideo come from gb300vid1010fix; sglang comes from gb300vid1010f3fix, after harness 1d771ec sends it 8 steps: sglang's native FastH3-V2 support counts DiT forwards and rejects 9. All three run the same eight forwards (vLLM-Omni is sent 8, FastVideo 9 sigma points).
replaced.cosmos3_nano_t2v_720p_189f (sglang): gb300img1010b (explicit speed mode, 23.06 s) is itself superseded by gb300img1010fix (22.98 s).

files.raw/: original runner output; exactly the merge inputs above
files.merged.json: merged artifact the Pages data was published from
files.issue.md: data-only tracker report with per-cell statuses and reasons
files.evidence/vllm-eager/: vLLM-Omni --enforce-eager on every case it supports (16 runner JSONs incl. FLUX.1 NUMA-pinned), for the eager-vs-eager check in summary.md
files.evidence/eager_main_rank1.log: sglang main eager against vLLM-Omni --enforce-eager, interleaved twice, MiniMax-H3 t2va and ref2va (the two leads under 5%)
files.evidence/eager_main_rank0.log: sglang main eager for the two cells published compiled (Cosmos3 T2I, LTX-2)
files.evidence/h200-eager/: the same eager-vs-eager check on a 2xH200 box (sglang main 6576e50cd5, vLLM-Omni f69b1f2b1 on vLLM 0.31.0): four vLLM-Omni runner JSONs and the run log with the sglang arms
